The '''scoop skimmer''', also known as a '''scoop speeder''', was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] used on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] as a transport and law enforcement vessel.

==Characteristics==
Green-hulled scoop skimmers were designed for use by [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'ans]], and the passenger compartment could seat four. Although chiefly used as transports, some were equipped with light [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] for law enforcement duties. They appeared somewhat similar in design to the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Mankvim-814 light interceptor/Legends|Mankvim-814 light interceptor]].

==History==
Besides Utapau, Scoop skimmers could also be found in the skies of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
